outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: a per-task timing queue in the drive state (TIMING_KEY; queue_stage once per source, stage_args, stages_carried) whose stages ride writes the drive already makes - the session note's `audit-task.py note --stage` and the close's `audit-task.py done --stage` - so no new commit and no new locked write (tm3 compares journal actions and commit count with a drive whose stages are never queued: equal). Sources: writer/reviewer session records (startedAt, durationMs; a record with no duration writes no stage), gate evidence rows (selection ending at startedAt, gate durationMs, runId), the base run's row, the commit timed around commit-task-work by the drive, and the wait from a session dispatch's or background gate's stamped hand-out to the step's start (wait_stage: a floored start one second early is a wait of 0 that says so, further back is none). NEW THIS ROUND, per the coordinator's three gaps: (1) audit-task.py `--stage` on note and done - not-JSON and stage_problems-graded values are refused before the lock; tmg6 asserts exit E_USAGE, the flag named in the refusal (stdout for note, stderr for done via _refuse_on_stderr) and the plan's and journal's bytes unchanged, on both verbs; tmg7 is the accepted twin. (2) The Agent route: dispatch() now stamps an executor or reviewer Agent's hand-out (agent_handed_out, under TIMING_KEY so the dispatched-<role> marks keep their values); once advance reads the return filed, queue_agent_stage writes a writer/reviewer stage from that stamp to the filing (filed_moment): the task.return.filed journal row for an executor, and - because no journal row files a reviewer's return, which the fixture showed - the filed file's modification time to the whole second, each named in the basis, with 'the agent's own start is not recorded, so any wait before it is inside this length'. No wait stage on that route. tm8 pins it. (3) Wave member: tm9 drives a waveWidth-2 fixture to integration and close and finds each member's writer, gate (the run measured in its own tree, runId and durationMs matching its evidence row) and commit stage in the phase tree's shard, and none in a member tree's plan - the argument held, no code change was needed. Mutation probes in a HEAD export with the working files overlaid (never the shared tree): 13 mutations, each red on its case (hand-out never stamped -> tm8,tm9; reviewer file time not read -> tm8; a wait written on the agent route -> tm8; stage not graded -> tmg6; not-JSON skipped -> tmg6,tmg7; wait never queued, absent duration read as zero, no selection stage, stages ride a note of their own, source dedupe dropped, same-second start dropped, moved clock read as a wait, base run not queued -> the tm cases named in the probe output), restored blocks 9/9 and 7/7. Commands: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0, '1/1 files ok, 1001 cases'; a wider sweep over test_drive_phase, test_audit_task, test_run_agent_session, test__refs, test_run_test_gate, test_drive_without_model, test__worktrees, test__task_timing, test_commit_task_work exit 0, '9/9 files ok, 3777 cases'; ruff exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- exit 0; house_style_violations, prose_number_claims and doc_prose_numbers report nothing on the changed files. Docs: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md drive-phase.py section and a CHANGELOG Unreleased bullet. (b) lr3's case label in tests/test_audit_task.py was changed with `sed -i` from Bash rather than the Edit tool - a label-text change only. (c) test_run_agent_session.py ras73 now compares the session readings minus the new startedAt/durationMs keys and asserts those two separately. NOT COVERED: the reviewer's Agent-route end is a file modification time, so a reviewer return touched after filing moves it, and no digest row guards it as one does the executor's; review_fix_dispatch and the phase-scope reviewer are not stamped, so a review-fix Agent round and a phase review leave no Agent stage; Agent-route stages carry no round; all stamps are whole seconds, so sub-second wait and Agent lengths are 0 or rounded; the mtime reading is exercised on macOS only, not Windows; plugins/audit/reference/orchestrator.md untouched as ordered.
